H5329: properly, to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent (as a superintendent, especially of the Temple services and its music); to be permanent
H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H2620: to flee for protection; figuratively, to confide in
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H5110: to nod, i.e. waver; figuratively, to wander, flee, disappear; also (from shaking the head in sympathy), to console, deplore, or (from tossing the head in scorn) taunt
H2022: a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively)
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H7563: morally wrong; concretely, an (actively) bad person
H1869: to tread; by implication, to walk; also to string abow (by treading on it in bending)
H7198: a bow, forshooting (hence, figuratively, strength) or the iris
H3559: properly, to be erect (i.e. stand perpendicular); hence (causatively) to set up, in a great variety of applications, whether literal (establish, fix, prepare, apply), or figurative (appoint, render sure, proper or prosperous)
H2671: properly, a piercer, i.e. an arrow; by implication, a wound; figuratively, (of God) thunderbolt; the shaft of aspear
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H3499: properly, an overhanging, i.e. (by implication) an excess, superiority, remainder; also a small rope (as hanging free)
H3384: properly, to flow as water (i.e. to rain); transitively, to lay or throw (especially an arrow, i.e. to shoot); figuratively, to point out (as if by aiming the finger), to teach
H3820: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
H8356: a basis, i.e. (figuratively) political or moral support
H2040: to pull down or in pieces, break, destroy
H4100: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses
H6466: to do or make (systematically and habitually), especially to practise
H1964: a large public building, such as a palace or temple
H6944: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract, sanctity
H8064: the sky (as aloft; the dual perhaps alluding to the visible arch in which the clouds move, as well as to the higher ether where the celestial bodies revolve)
H3678: properly, covered, i.e. a throne (as canopied)
H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
H2372: to gaze at; mentally to perceive, contemplate (with pleasure); specifically, to have avision of
H6079: an eyelash (as fluttering); figuratively, morning ray
H974: to test (especially metals); generally and figuratively, to investigate
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H120: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.)
H157: to have affection for (sexually or otherwise)
H2555: violence; by implication, wrong; by meton. unjust gain
H6341: a (metallic) sheet (as pounded thin); also a spring net (as spread out like a lamina)
H1614: properly, cypress-resin; by analogy, sulphur (as equally inflammable)
H7307: wind; by resemblance breath, i.e. a sensible (or even violent) exhalation; figuratively, life, anger, unsubstantiality; by extension, a region of the sky; by resemblance spirit, but only of a rational being (including its expression and functions)
H2152: a glow (of wind or anger); also a famine (as consuming)
H4521: an allotment (by courtesy, law or providence)
H3563: a cup (as a container), often figuratively, a lot (as if a potion); also some unclean bird, probably an owl (perhaps from the cup-like cavity of its eye)
H6666: rightness (abstractly), subjectively (rectitude), objectively (justice), morally (virtue) or figuratively (prosperity)
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
